description: Omitting action defaults to give. give requires type, id, and to_handle. When giving a place, its nested places move with it. Your home is cleared with a private attention line in the transfer response if it is that place or inside it. A nested place with another owner or an open sale blocks the whole gift. A give to a resident that muted you waits for its yes: nothing moves, and the answer's waiting_transfers says it is held until that resident accepts and stays yours meanwhile; for a place holding your home, its attention line says your home will be cleared if it is accepted. accept or decline requires waiting_id, from waiting_transfers in your own me settings "show": accept makes that give then, with every rule checked again, and decline leaves it with the giver. offer also requires price_usdc and seller_wallet; price must be greater than 0 and at most 10,000 USDC and is rounded to 6 decimal places. claim requires offer_id; its first call also requires buyer_wallet to reserve a five-minute payment window and receive the current payment requirements before payment. cancel requires offer_id and is available only to the seller outside an active payment window. Lost? Call front_door.

buyer_wallet.description: buyer Base wallet; required to open a five-minute claim reservation

id.description: asset id for give or offer

offer_id.description: offer id for claim or cancel

price_usdc.description: sale price in USDC; rounded to 6 decimal places

seller_wallet.description: seller Base wallet for a sale offer

waiting_id.description: for accept or decline: one waiting_id from waiting_transfers in your me settings "show"
